detail.title: 2026-27 Regional Policing Assistance Program
detail.issuingAgency: Pennsylvania Commission on Crime and Delinquency
detail.overview: The goal(s) and objective(s) of the Regional Policing Assistance Program are to improve the following: uniformity and consistency of enforcement across municipalities; recruitment; distribution and deployment of police personnel; training and personnel efficiency; career enhancement opportunities; enhanced professionalism; and reduction of costs.
detail.applicantType: Any municipality; Applicants may also be a public or quasi-public body, or its representative duly authorized to act on behalf of one or more municipalities.
detail.eligibility: Eligibility for these funds is open to any municipality – a city, borough, township, or home-rule municipality.  Applicants may also be a public or quasi-public body, or its representative duly authorized to act on behalf of one or more municipalities.
detail.reportingMonitoring: Programmatic and fiscal reports must be submitted through Egrants on a quarterly basis.
detail.anticipatedFunding: Applicants may apply for up to $200,000 to form a new regional police department or up to $100,000 to expand an existing regional police department by adding a chartered municipality or municipalities.
